environment.description: EKS 1.28 pod in 'cache-prod' namespace with PodSecurity admission controller enforcing 'restricted' profile at namespace level. SecurityContext drops ALL capabilities then adds only CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE. Specifically CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN are absent. Container runs as non-root (UID 65534). Seccomp profile set to RuntimeDefault (containerd's default filter). Image built on distroless/static-debian12 with hardened allocator (scudo via custom LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/libscudo.so with quarantine_size_kb=4096, dealloc_type_mismatch=true, pattern_fill_after_free=0xAB). The scudo allocator's quarantine delays reuse of freed chunks for 4MB worth of allocations and fills freed memory with 0xAB pattern bytes, causing immediate SIGSEGV on UAF dereference rather than exploitable memory reuse.
